description: This PHP class defines a list container handler for the HTMLPurifier library, specifically managing 'ul' and 'ol' HTML list elements and their child 'li' elements, including validation and structure adjustments.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_List
classes.description: A class handling list element validation and child management for HTMLPurifier's list nodes, managing 'ul' and 'ol' structures and their 'li' children.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and processes the children nodes of a list, ensuring proper 'li' elements and nesting, and handling whitespace and structural errors.
